name: tests-50pct-tortoise-orm-portable-collision-safe-schema-5099
instr:
Support reversible, collision-safe migration batches that rename tables, fields, indexes, and constraints as one logical operation. Callers should see stable logical mappings while planning and execution may use temporary physical identities to complete swaps and longer cycles. Autodetection, projected state, serialization, SQL collection, execution, and reversal must preserve the same object identities.

A rename batch is validated before state mutation or editor execution, rejecting duplicate scoped sources, conflicting destinations, incompatible scopes, and missing projected objects with `RenameConflictError`, a `ValueError` carrying the offending target and reason. Planning is deterministic and collision-free, preserves logical input order, produces exact inverse mappings, and never exposes temporary identities as final results. Applying a valid batch updates model, relation, index, constraint, and field references atomically; applying and unapplying it restores definitions, relationships, data, names, and serialized state. Autodetection combines compatible overlapping identities into one `RenameObjects` operation without absorbing unrelated changes, and `MigrationWriter` round-trips every ordered `RenameTarget` attribute deterministically. SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, and Oracle produce equivalent logical results while preserving dependent objects through collision-free native operations that honor each dialect's qualification, namespaces, reconstruction rules, meta
